🚀 bybit-ws | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: Automated, AI-driven cryptocurrency futures trading on Bybit with robust risk management.
✨ Key Features: • AI-Native Trading Engine • Bollinger Bands + AI Scoring for Entry • Automated LONG/SHORT Trading • Advanced Risk Management (Stop-loss, Take-profit, Trailing, DCA) • Deposit Protection (Circuit Breaker, BlackSwan, Anti-ludomania)
📖 Summary: Bybit-WS is an AI-native trading engine designed for 24/7 automated trading on the Bybit futures market. It utilizes Bollinger Bands combined with a 9-metric AI scoring system for entry points, and incorporates advanced risk management and deposit protection features.
